MEMORANDUM. To: Board of [AUTHORITY]. From: Staff. Re: Proposed $12,000,000 taxable revenue bond and PILOT for [COMPANY]'s [PROJECT] in [COUNTY].

Bond terms: 20-year term, 4.50% fixed rate, level monthly payments of $75,918 ($911,015 annually). Total interest over 240 payments is $6,220,303. Projected net operating income of $1,500,000 supports debt service coverage of 1.65x.

Capital and leverage: total investment is $27,000,000 ($18,000,000 real property plus $9,000,000 equipment). Loan-to-value is 0.444 on that basis. Equipment is not part of the PILOT and is excluded from tax calculations. On the real property alone, loan-to-value would be 0.667. The board should confirm which denominator policy uses, since the spec defines total capital investment to include equipment.

PILOT: Full annual tax on the real property is $205,200 (40% assessment, 28.5 mills on $7,200,000 assessed value). Years 1 to 5 are fully abated. The year 7 PILOT payment is $41,040 (80% abated, 20% payable). Over years 1 to 15, abated taxes total $1,949,400 and PILOT payments total $1,128,600. Present value of abated amounts at 5.0% is $1,496,856, with year 1 discounted one full period.

Jobs: 150 full-time positions at a $52,000 average wage yield a $7,800,000 annual payroll and $12,996 of abated taxes per job over 15 years.
